patch.value: The full audit found src/index.ts and src/storage/index.ts concentrating parsing, routing, IO, formatting, and lifecycle behavior. Plan incremental extractions rather than a rewrite: define stable seams, move one coherent command family at a time, add contract tests before movement, and ratchet per-file coverage as ownership becomes clearer.
Decompose command and storage monoliths behind tested module boundaries
Reduce change risk in the 2,660-line command dispatcher and 1,368-line storage module through incremental extraction and contract tests.

Command families have explicit module ownership; storage concerns are split by responsibility; public CLI and SDK behavior remains compatible; per-file coverage improves without disabling global gates
A dependency map and prioritized extraction sequence are reviewed.

value.text: Implementation will preserve existing flag compatibility while adding a centralized response adapter, explicit command help for every advertised command, deterministic global setup at ~/.searxng-cli, and live-instance E2E proof. The local service URL is http://192.168.1.183:38522.

value.author: codex-root
value.text: SearXNG intentionally returns 403 when a requested output format is disabled. Full client compatibility therefore requires content negotiation and HTML response parsing rather than assuming JSON API availability.

value.author: codex-root
value.text: Coverage hardening complete: all 20 test files and 930 tests pass with honest repo-wide V8 coverage at 100% statements (4645/4645), branches (3389/3389), functions (525/525), and lines (4346/4346). No source exclusions or artificial ignore directives were added. The monolithic dispatcher was improved through exported lifecycle/diagnostic parsers, deterministic background-refresh handling, shared self-test assertions, and exhaustive real command-path matrices.
